result:
The crash happened because the allergy form's chart wrapper reads the patient from the patient-chart workspace group, and the pharmacist's order basket runs in a different window with no such group. The fix is commit `160e8d0` (PR #3353), which adds an exported allergy form that takes the patient from window props. I could not find a ticket key in the fix commit, so the ticket field below is a fallback, not a confirmed fix ticket.

**Why it crashed outside the chart**

- The chart's `AllergyFormWorkspace` wrapper takes `patient` and `patientUuid` from `groupProps` (`packages/esm-patient-allergies-app/src/allergies/allergies-form/allergy-form.workspace.tsx:616-634` @file:{openmrs-esm-patient-chart::packages/esm-patient-allergies-app/src/allergies/allergies-form/allergy-form.workspace.tsx:616-634}). Outside the chart there is no patient-chart group, so the patient context is missing. The regression test describes this as the order basket "Add allergy" crash (`allergy-form.test.tsx:168-170` @file:{openmrs-esm-patient-chart::packages/esm-patient-allergies-app/src/allergies/allergies-form/allergy-form.test.tsx:168-170`).
- The fix does two things. It adds an exported variant that reads the patient from window props (`exported-allergy-form.workspace.tsx:10-21` @file:{openmrs-esm-patient-chart::packages/esm-patient-allergies-app/src/allergies/allergies-form/exported-allergy-form.workspace.tsx:10-21}). It also changes the chart wrapper to `groupProps?.patient`, so a missing group no longer throws a TypeError (`allergy-form.workspace.tsx:616-619` @file:{openmrs-esm-patient-chart::packages/esm-patient-allergies-app/src/allergies/allergies-form/allergy-form.workspace.tsx:616-619}).

**What is launched instead**

- The dispensing app's "Fill prescription" flow opens the order basket with `allergyFormWorkspaceName: 'dispensing-order-basket-add-allergy-workspace'` (`openmrs-esm-dispensing-app/src/fill-prescription/fill-prescription-button.component.tsx:42-59` @file:{openmrs-esm-dispensing-app::src/fill-prescription/fill-prescription-button.component.tsx:42-59}).
- That name is registered in `routes.json` as `@openmrs/esm-patient-allergies-app#exportedAllergyFormWorkspace`, in the fill-prescription window (`openmrs-esm-dispensing-app/src/routes.json:115-119` @file:{openmrs-esm-dispensing-app::src/routes.json:115-119}).
- The exported drug-order workspace launches that child workspace with `formContext: 'creating'` when the "+" allergy action is pressed (`openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-patient-medications-app/src/add-drug-order/exported-add-drug-order.workspace.tsx:21-26` @file:{openmrs-esm-patient-chart::packages/esm-patient-medications-app/src/add-drug-order/exported-add-drug-order.workspace.tsx:21-26}). The allergy-launcher prop is documented at `add-drug-order.component.tsx:52` @file:{openmrs-esm-patient-chart::packages/esm-patient-medications-app/src/add-drug-order/add-drug-order.component.tsx:52}.
- The window prop that carries the name is documented in `order.ts:334-339` @file:{openmrs-esm-patient-chart::packages/esm-patient-common-lib/src/orders/types/order.ts:334-339}.
- The export itself is in `packages/esm-patient-allergies-app/src/index.ts:61-65` @file:{openmrs-esm-patient-chart::packages/esm-patient-allergies-app/src/index.ts:61-65}.

**Which change fixed it**

- Commit `160e8d0bc956f1e4d774a4a7f1047c06b8f18fda`, "(fix) Allow recording allergies from the order basket outside the patient chart (#3353)", by Dennis Kigen, 2026-06-04. It is the only commit matching that subject, and its body is empty. Its diff adds the `exportedAllergyFormWorkspace` export (confirmed via `get_diff`).
- The wider feature came from `6de29927bd14a8cbe34db3aa522b14e2f4ef8df4`, "(feat) O3-5540: Add quick-add allergy action to drug order basket (#3186)". That commit added the "+" affordance that the crash occurred on. It is not the fix.

**Ticket**

- No ticket key appears in the fix commit or PR #3353. The only ticket I found nearby is O3-5540 on the quick-add feature commit, which is unconfirmed as the fix ticket.

I did not modify any files.
